items.q: How do I become a member of Smart Community?
items.a: Membership is open to all residents and community stakeholders. Simply visit the Volunteer Registration section or contact our community office. New members receive a welcome package, community guide, and access to all digital platforms.

items.q: What facilities are available in the community?
items.a: Our community features a Community Hall, Health Clinic, Children's Playground, Sports Center with gym and pool, and a 2-acre Central Park. All facilities are accessible to all residents.

items.q: How can I report a maintenance issue or safety concern?
items.a: You can report issues through the Community Assistant chatbot, email myceliumresidence07@gmail.com, or call our 24/7 hotline at +60 10-557 0900. All non-emergency reports are addressed within 48 hours.

items.q: Are there age-specific programs and activities?
items.a: Yes! We offer programs for all ages: toddler storytime, youth sports leagues, adult fitness classes, and senior wellness walks.

items.q: How does the community newsletter work?
items.a: Our weekly newsletter is delivered every Monday morning via email. Subscribe at the bottom of this page or at the community office.

items.q: What are the community rules and guidelines?
items.a: Key guidelines include: quiet hours from 10 PM to 7 AM, proper waste sorting, pet leash requirements, and parking regulations.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content:
1. Information We Collect

We may collect personal information you voluntarily provide, including your name, contact number, email address, and house address when you submit feedback, register for volunteer activities, or use community services.

2. How We Use Your Information

  • To provide and maintain community services and facilities
  • To send important announcements, event notifications and service updates
  • To respond to your inquiries and feedback
  • To improve community management and user experience

3. Information Sharing

We do not sell, rent or disclose your personal information to third parties for commercial purposes.

4. Data Security

We adopt appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal information.

5. Your Rights

You have the right to access, correct or request deletion of your personal information.

6. Contact Us

If you have any questions, please contact myceliumresidence07@gmail.com.

rules.title: Community Rules
rules.content:
1. Public Area Etiquette

Keep public areas clean and tidy. Take good care of public facilities.

2. Quiet Hours

Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM daily.

3. Pet Management

Pets must be kept on a leash in public areas.

airQuality.title: Air quality today
airQuality.sub: Estimated US AQI for your community's area, updated through the day.
airQuality.error: Air quality data is unavailable right now.
airQuality.source: Modelled estimate from Copernicus Atmosphere Monitoring Service data via Open-Meteo. It is not an official monitoring-station reading.
airQuality.adviceGood: Air quality is satisfactory. It is a good time to be outdoors.
airQuality.adviceModerate: Acceptable for most people. Unusually sensitive people may want to take it easier outdoors.
airQuality.adviceSensitive: Children, older adults and people with heart or lung conditions should limit long outdoor exertion.
airQuality.adviceUnhealthy: Everyone should reduce prolonged outdoor exertion. Sensitive groups should stay indoors where possible.
airQuality.adviceVeryUnhealthy: Avoid outdoor activity where you can. Keep windows closed.
airQuality.adviceHazardous: Stay indoors with windows closed and follow guidance from local authorities.

smartFacilitiesModal: Pay community charges and facility fees through a clear, convenient digital flow. Residents can review what they owe and keep a record of completed payments. This exhibition version uses a sandbox checkout, so no real money is charged.
Check availability and reserve shared spaces such as the gym, pool or community hall. A booking calendar helps residents plan ahead and avoid double bookings.
Submit requests for shared supplies or maintenance work and follow each request from submission to completion, helping management keep decisions transparent.
Send forms such as maintenance requests and resident applications online, then receive a clear confirmation so there is less paperwork and fewer follow-up calls.
communitySafetyModal: Keep service agreements, renewal dates and related documents organized in one place, so residents and management can understand what has been agreed.
Register expected guests and let residents know when a visitor arrives. Clear check-in steps help make entry smoother while preserving a human welcome.
Use shared-area camera systems to help the management team review safety incidents. Monitoring should follow local privacy rules and posted community policies.
Coordinate patrol routes and record observations so the team can respond consistently to concerns around entrances, paths and shared facilities.
greenLivingModal: Adjust watering schedules to weather and planting needs, helping gardens stay healthy while reducing avoidable water use.
Make recycling and composting easier to understand with clear sorting guidance and collection points residents can find around the community.
Provide charging points for electric vehicles and show residents where they are located, supporting lower-emission travel as the community grows.
Track practical steps such as efficient lighting and equipment schedules to reduce energy waste in shared spaces without compromising comfort.
